reset.title: Account rescue
reset.intro: For the SocialGrid owners only. Enter your recovery code to see every login (team and customers), set new passwords, or create a test customer.
reset.done: Password changed. You can log in with the new password now.
reset.disabledText: To switch it on, the Vercel project owner sets a recovery code once:
reset.disabledStep1: Vercel → socialgrid project → Settings → Environment Variables.
reset.disabledStep2: Add a variable named RECOVERY_CODE with a long secret phrase you choose (at least 12 characters), for Production.
reset.disabledStep3: Redeploy the project, then come back here and enter that phrase as the recovery code.

landing.waText: Hi SocialGrid, I'd like to know more.
landing.sub: Send a voice note or a message. Your own design team creates your posts and plans your week. You just download and share.

phone.reply: Got it, Sunita ji! Ready by 6 PM today.

landing.howTitle: As easy as a voice note.
landing.howSub: No apps to learn, no designs to fiddle with. If you can use WhatsApp, you can use SocialGrid.

1.title: Tell us what you need.
1.text: Speak or type, in Hindi or English. Add a few photos from your phone if you like.

2.title: We create it.
2.text: A real designer makes your post and writes the caption, and you see exactly when it will be ready.

3.title: You share it.
3.text: Pick the one you love, ask for changes if you want, then download and share in a tap.

landing.workSub: Every post is designed by a person, in your colours, around your offer.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

plan.title: Your week, planned.
plan.text: Festivals, offers and everyday posts, decided before the week begins. You never wonder what to post next.

lang.title: Your language.
lang.text: The whole app works in Hindi and English. Switch any time.

time.title: Always know when.
time.text: Every request shows its ready time and where it is right now.

changes.title: Changes, until you love it.
changes.text: Tap what to change, or just say it. We send a new version.

landing.priceTitle: A plan that fits your month.
landing.priceSub: Pricing depends on how many posts you need. Tell us about your business and we'll suggest the right plan.

instagram.q: Do I need to know Instagram?
instagram.a: No. We send the finished post and caption. You download and share it, and we'll show you how the first time.

hindi.a: Yes. The whole app works in Hindi and English, and you can send voice notes instead of typing.

speed.q: How fast will I get my post?
speed.a: Usually the same day. Every request shows the exact time it will be ready, and you can mark urgent ones.

changes.q: What if I don't like it?
changes.a: Tap "Ask for changes" and tell us what to fix. We send a new version.

photos.a: Phone photos are fine. When we need something specific, we'll tell you what to click.

price.a: It depends on how many posts you need each month. Message us and we'll share the plans.

landing.closeTitle: Your next post is one voice note away.
landing.closeSub: Message us on WhatsApp. A real person will reply.
landing.closeSoon: Our WhatsApp number is coming soon. Until then, ask the person who shared this link with you.
landing.footer: Content created and planned for your business.
